description.value: Kelz Bakery is a scratch bakery that has served Sooke for over 35 years, run by Kelly and Yvonne with a combined 40 years of baking experience. The shop offers an extensive range of sweet treats — cakes, cupcakes, pastries, and artisan bread — alongside savory options including meat pies, quiches, and sandwiches made with locally sourced ingredients where possible. Custom-designed celebration and wedding cakes are a specialty, making it a notable stop for cyclists looking for a substantial baked snack or a sweet reward.
